official_definition: Grand Soar (When Attacks) At the end of battle, by either paying one cost or putting one core from a Green Grandwalker Nexus you control to this Spirit, this Spirit refreshes.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Grand Soar] or [Grand Soar: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Grand Soar]", "give [Grand Soar]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
